hooks.name: Auto Test on Save
hooks.description: Automatically run tests when TypeScript or JavaScript files are saved with minimal verbosity

action.prompt: A code file has been saved. Run the appropriate tests for this file and report any failures. IMPORTANT: Use minimal verbosity to prevent session timeouts - add --silent, --quiet, or similar flags. If this is a test file, run it directly with filtering (--grep, --testNamePattern). If this is a source file, find and run related tests. Use commands like: npm test -- --silent, yarn test --silent, npx jest --silent --testNamePattern='specific', or pytest -q -k 'test_name'.
